title: Training & Placement Cell
overview: This page stores NPGC student services information for Training & Placement Cell. Captured source headings include: Training & Placement Cell, Message from Manager, Message from Principal, Training & Placement Cell Team. Source page: https://www.npgc.in/StudentSupport-Placements.aspx
content:
The Training & placement Cell aims to ensure students securing suitable employment opportunities and launch their successful careers by facilitating job placements, bridge the gap between academia and industry by enhancing employability skills, career guidance and support through organizing recruitment drives and job fairs.
The National Post Graduate College's placement cell has a new structure, comprising 1 placement Head, 8 teacher coordinators, 16 students, and 3 core members. The cell's goal is to invite companies to the college, providing opportunities for final year and other students through internships and training programs. The cell ensures a smooth recruitment process for both the students and visiting companies.
Message from Manager
Welcome to the esteemed halls of National Post Graduate College, where academic excellence converges with a commitment to shaping successful futures. As the Manager, I feel the responsibility of providing transformative educational experience to the students. National PG College is not merely an institution; it's a Launchpad for promising careers. Our unwavering focus extends beyond the classroom, into the dynamic realm of professional placements. Our Placement Cell has proven to be a beacon of success. We take pride in cultivating strong industry connections that pave the way for our students' seamless integration into the professional landscape.
At National PG College, we understand the evolving demands of the job market. The Placement Cell, reflective of our commitment, diligently facilitates connections with leading companies, ensuring that our graduates and postgraduates step confidently into their chosen careers. Join us on this journey where academic aspirations meet real-world success, creating a legacy of empowered and accomplished individuals. National PG College: Nurturing Minds, shaping future. My heartfelt regards to all as we venture together on the path to success and fulfilment.
Mr. Ujjawal Raman Singh Manager
Message from Principal
Penning down this message about the significance of our prestigious institution as well as the vital role of our Placement Cell, gives me immense pride and joy.
Our college believes in holistic education, where academic excellence is complemented by character development, leadership skills, and a strong sense of social responsibility. NPGC takes pride in its alumni's glitter and a successful track of placements. From providing inter-school training, to giving opportunities of professional interviews, the college leaves no stone unturned, to help students correlate with prospective employers.
The Placement Cell, driven by students, serves as the bridge between their academic journey and the professional world. It dedicates to improve the abilities, provide them exposure to the business, and put them in equivalence with top companies. Our students put forth a lot of effort to build relationships with prime business organisations.
It is a pleasure for me to be in charge of this prestigious university. I'm dedicated to create a climate that values respect for one another, academic achievement, and personal development. Warm regards to all, and I look forward to our collective journey of growth and success.
Prof. Devendra Kumar Singh Principal
